newsitem.title: UK: GWR Group sells NZ radio group for NZ$40 mln.
newsitem.headline: GWR Group sells NZ radio group for NZ$40 mln.

text.p: GWR Group Plc said on Friday it has sold Prospect, a New Zealand radio group with 12 stations, to Radio Network of New Zealand (RNNZ) for NZ$40 million (17.1 million stg) in cash, representing a net profit of 3.8 million stg.

GWR acquired Prospect in February for NZ$29.8 million (13.1 million stg). It later tendered, unsuccessfully for Radio New Zealand, losing out to RNNZ "at a price which GWR believed it would not have been prudent to offer."
GWR said the disposal is expected to enhance its earnings per share, adding it will use the proceeds to reduce debt. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
